skill.name: gate-dex-market
skill.description: Query public Gate Wallet DEX market data, token details, rankings, new token listings, liquidity, and risk information through MCP tools. The skill is read-only and does not execute trades.
skill.summary: Read-only Gate Wallet DEX market data and token risk queries.
skill.author: gate

content.value_statement: On-chain token research needs fast, consistent public market data. This skill retrieves Gate Wallet DEX prices, liquidity, rankings, and risk information through MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Checks that the Gate DEX MCP server is reachable before running workflows.
Retrieves K-line data for a token by chain, address, interval, and limit.
Gets token transaction statistics and pair liquidity for market summaries.
Returns token details such as symbol, supply, holders, price, and market cap.
Lists ranked or newly created tokens by chain and selected parameters.
Displays token risk information from the public risk audit tool.
limitations: Requires a configured Gate DEX MCP server named gate-dex-mcp.
Does not execute trades, submit transactions, or manage wallets.
Uses public market data and may not cover every chain or token.
Risk results are informational and are not financial advice.

use_cases.title: Compare token activity
use_cases.description: Review price movement, buy and sell activity, and liquidity for a token before deeper research.

use_cases.title: Screen new listings
use_cases.description: Find recently created tokens on a chain and add risk checks before spending more research time.

use_cases.title: Summarize market context
use_cases.description: Create a clear market snapshot for users who ask about token price, volume, or contract risk.

prompt_templates.title: Check one token
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single market summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current market data for this token on Ethereum: [token contract address]. Include price trend, transaction stats, and liquidity.

prompt_templates.title: Review token details
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic token lookup before market analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Get token details for [token contract address] on [chain]. Summarize symbol, supply, holders, price, market cap, and website if available.

prompt_templates.title: Find ranked tokens
prompt_templates.prompt: List the top [number] tokens on [chain] by [market cap, volume, price change, or holders]. Highlight major movers and liquidity context.

prompt_templates.title: Build a research workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow that combines discovery, risk, and market checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find new tokens created on [chain] during [time range]. For each candidate, summarize details, risk status, liquidity, and recent transaction activity.

output_examples.input: Show 24-hour market data for USDT on Ethereum.
output_examples.output: A concise market summary with price movement, transaction counts, buy and sell volume, liquidity, and suggested follow-up checks.

output_examples.input: Audit this token contract before I research it further.
output_examples.output: A risk summary showing audit status, contract verification, owner status, risk items, and a reminder to investigate independently.

output_examples.input: Find new BSC tokens from the last day.
output_examples.output: A ranked discovery list with token names, contract addresses, creation times, prices, market caps, holders, and risk check prompts.

best_practices: Confirm the chain and contract address before requesting token data.
Run a risk check before interpreting new token market activity.
Treat market data as informational and verify important details with independent sources.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to execute trades or approve transactions.
Do not treat token rankings as investment recommendations.
Do not continue workflows when the configured MCP server is unavailable.

faq.question: Does this skill require authentication?
faq.answer: The documented market tools use public data and do not require an MCP token.

faq.question: Can it execute trades?
faq.answer: No. The skill is read-only and does not submit transactions or manage wallets.

faq.question: Which data can it retrieve?
faq.answer: It can retrieve K-line data, transaction statistics, liquidity, token details, rankings, new listings, and risk information.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Your AI coding tool must have a Gate DEX MCP server configured with the name gate-dex-mcp.

faq.question: Can it provide investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It should present market and risk data for reference without recommending purchases or sales.

faq.question: What happens if no risk data is found?
faq.answer: The skill should report that no security information was found and advise independent investigation.
